input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: The warranty package meets the preferred position. Section 19.1 gives a professional and workmanlike services warranty plus material conformance to documentation and specifications; 19.2 gives a 90-day Deliverable conformance warranty (running from the later of delivery or acceptance) and a hosted-Services conformance warranty for the whole subscription term, which exceeds the 12-month software benchmark; 19.3 adds no-malicious-code and compliance-with-Applicable-Law warranties; and 19.4 supplies the full remedy ladder of prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, with termination and refund of Fees paid if Vendor cannot cure, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The disclaimer in 19.5 is limited to implied warranties and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranties. No redline needed.
